headline: US Approves SpaceX Plan to Launch One Million Orbital Satellites for AI Datacentres
summary: The Trump administration has approved Elon Musk’s SpaceX to launch one million Starmind orbital satellites to process data in space, aiming to improve energy efficiency for AI datacentres.
why: Data center energy consumption is a major bottleneck for the artificial intelligence industry, and space-based infrastructure represents a radical shift in technology scaling.

impacts.name: SpaceX
impacts.why: Regulatory approval allows the company to proceed with its major satellite constellation project.
